ambient_events: Your boots sink to the ankle in soft grey silt and pull free with a sucking pop.
A drift of pale roach-cases crunches somewhere in the dark.
The air here is thick enough to taste, still and old.
description: A wide, silted-up gallery where the flow slows and drops its load: decades of grey sediment banked in dunes against the walls. Things live in the silt; you can see the tracks. A branch runs east to a flooded overflow, and south a heavy service door stands sealed in its frame.
name: Silt Gallery
